changes_made.explanation: Consolidated task names to single canonical form. Added missing auditory LLM models that were evaluated. Removed Whisper and BEATs as they are encoders, not NLG models. Vicuna is the LLM backbone but not the primary NLG model being evaluated.
Consolidated duplicate metric names and normalized to standard forms. PCC is explicitly Pearson Correlation Coefficient in the paper.
Consolidated methods into two main categories: pairwise relevance scoring and general description comparison. The paper uses GPT to compare descriptions and generate relevance scores.

guideline: Please evaluate the quality of the speech sample from various aspects. Please read the explanations provided for each aspect carefully before scoring and select the score you find most appropriate. You may need to provide more detailed information if there is any noise, distortion or unnatural pause.

changes_made.explanation: Changed answer from No to Yes. The paper clearly describes human annotation process with 25 annotators who rate speech samples across multiple criteria and revise GPT-generated descriptions. This constitutes human evaluation of the generated outputs.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on speech quality assessment using natural language descriptions. It involves both human evaluation (25 annotators rating speech samples and revising descriptions) and automatic evaluation using various metrics. LLMs are used both for generation (auditory LLMs) and evaluation (GPT as judge). The extraction was generally good but missed some important details about human evaluation and the full range of auditory LLMs evaluated.
